programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: In an old school Las Vegas casino, its top gambling jinx breaks his curse when he falls in love, much to his boss' consternation.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Peter Five Eight
programme.desc: Sam, a seemingly poised and glamorous real estate agent in a small mountain community is revealed to be an unhinged and troubled alcoholic with a dark secret, when a charismatic man in a black sedan named Peter shows up in town one day.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Blood Of Redemption
programme.desc: When the most powerful criminal empire in the land comes crumbling down from within, it is up to a former henchman to put the puzzle pieces together in order to find those responsible and extract revenge.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: Locked In [Extended Version]
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.title: Juvenile
programme.desc: Troublemaker Billy Forsetti falls for the beautiful Jennifer. But when a carjacking takes a turn for the worse, Billy finds himself in for trouble.

programme.title: What You Wish For
programme.desc: A down-on-his-luck chef with gambling problems flees to a Latin American villa to join a team of chefs who cook for the super rich. He soon gets more than he bargained for when he discovers the dark secrets of his employer's unique and dangerous culinary appetite

programme.title: High Voltage [Extended Version]
programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor's life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: The Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: Ann (Heather Graham) is a yoga teacher struggling to achieve inner peace despite the fact her family is driving her crazy and her dating life is miserable.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all relationships in order to prevent heartache.

programme.title: Enter The Clones of Bruce
programme.desc: Enter the Clones of Bruce dives into the Bruce Lee exploitation craze, otherwise known as Bruceploitation.

programme.title: No One Lives
programme.desc: A gang of ruthless highway killers kidnap a wealthy couple traveling cross country only to shockingly discover that things are not what they seem.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: The Legion [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Broken Star [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: The Coca Cola Kid
programme.desc: A smug sales executive treks to Australia to improve regional sales and becomes embroiled in sexual and professional shenanigans.

programme.title: Tim
programme.desc: A somewhat mentally handicapped 20-year-old man works as a laborer, but everyone abuses his naivety. A nice 40-year-old American woman hires him one day and they become close. However, the town and his family see her as predatory.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: A South African gold mine foreman is unwittingly manipulated by an unscrupulous gang of financiers who want to flood the mine to raise the price of gold on the world market.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Pocket Listing

programme.title: The Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Fried Rice
programme.desc: Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna; sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

programme.title: Fennel Orange Salad
programme.desc: Host Tiera Singh gets the show on the road with her Italian- inspired Fennel Orange Salad. Seared sushi-grade tuna rests on top of a crunchy, zesty, tangy fennel and orange salad with a honey-vinegar dressing to sweeten it up! Micah Trainor's revamp? Five Spice Duck a L'Orange with a sugary caramelized orange sauce and duck fat fried potatoes - is it French? Chinese? Who knows, but it's delicious! Next, Poppy Sandler pulls off a vegetarian variation, with a Roasted Veggie Bouillabaisse, complete with musky morels, umami-packed kombu, and tender asparagus. Missy Hui finishes up with her Orange Licorice Panna Cotta - aromatic orange blossom honey and licorice-like fennel pollen make the dish a decadent denouement to this episode of Up the Dish!

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Molise
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Valle D'Aosta
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Veneto
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Puglia
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Sicily
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Lazio
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Campania
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Emilia Romagna
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Calabria
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Lombardy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Umbria
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Sardegna
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Friuli Venezia Guilia
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. programme.title: Yellow
programme.desc: Say hello to yellow with chef Pino Di Cerbo as he brightens each dish with glowing, golden-hued produce! Corn on the cob gets a fun presentation as 'ribs', chopped into spears, spiked with harissa spices, and grilled until smoky. Finally, stick around for a Thai-inspired noodle salad, where even the noodles are veggies! Strands of mildly sweet spaghetti squash paired with nutty cashews, tender sprouts and a punchy ginger-rice vinaigrette!

programme.title: The New Detectives: Without A Trace
programme.desc: Missing Person- Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples. In addition to pictures on milk cartons, store windows, and in mass mailings, authorities use nationwide computer databases to help locate missing persons or match them with unidentified bodies. Even so, many of the missing are never seen again.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Island Fever
programme.desc: In the summer of 2001, Debby Stoner’s family begins to exhibit severe flu like symptoms. Upon visiting the family, who live in a small village on Maui, doctors discover that others are also suffering from strange symptoms including headaches, fevers and a bizarre red rash. Health officials are concerned they are dealing with a terrifying virus that is spread by mosquitoes. It is an outbreak of Dengue Fever, imported to the island by travelers from Tahiti. The disease has the potential to spread to other islands and eventually the mainland. In a matter of days, more cases are reported in towns nearby. Without a vaccine or cure, the only option for health officials is to track the virus and eradicate the source, wherever it is found.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains- It’s difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence. But what happens when the charred remains are found, unrecognizable, seemingly impossible to identify? Dr. John Verano and Dr. Doug Owsley of the Smithsonian have faced these challenges, identifying the burned remains of two American journalists found in Guatemala seven years after their reported disappearance. It seems as though fire can unveil lies, as well as conceal truths.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains- It’s difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence. But what happens when the charred remains are found, unrecognizable, seemingly impossible to identify? Dr. John Verano and Dr. Doug Owsley of the Smithsonian have faced these challenges, identifying the burned remains of two American journalists found in Guatemala seven years after their reported disappearance. It seems as though fire can unveil lies, as well as conceal truths.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Home Ivasion
programme.desc: In the summer of 2001, Debby Stoner’s family begins to exhibit severe flu like symptoms. Upon visiting the family, who live in a small village on Maui, doctors discover that others are also suffering from strange symptoms including headaches, fevers and a bizarre red rash. Health officials are concerned they are dealing with a terrifying virus that is spread by mosquitoes. It is an outbreak of Dengue Fever, imported to the island by travelers from Tahiti. The disease has the potential to spread to other islands and eventually the mainland. In a matter of days, more cases are reported in towns nearby. Without a vaccine or cure, the only option for health officials is to track the virus and eradicate the source, wherever it is found.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations- The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which as mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid the box exploded killing her instantly. Within minutes, five other bombs exploded proving to be as fatal as the first. The investigation into this serial bombing case became one of the most massive investigations in history.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Sudden Death
programme.desc: During December of 1999, public health authorities in Alberta, Canada are notified of two cases of a rare form of bacterial meningitis. A third reported case claims the life of a seventeen-year-old. Soon after, six more cases are reported and another young life is taken. Health officials think a new strain of the bacteria may be invading the population. The Provincial Laboratory discovers that a new genetic strain has indeed been introduced, but luckily, the meningitis vaccine that exists will still work against it. The Public Health Authority must act quickly to vaccinate and immunize over 50,000 young people before the bacteria claims any more victims.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Death Grip
programme.desc: Fingerprinting- The identification Division of the FBI relies on fingerprints as one of the most effective ways to identify criminals. Fingerprints, along with palmprints and footprints are an indisputable, time-tested method to establish someone’s ID beyond a shadow of a doubt. Computerization has all but eliminated the old inkpad, and print identification that used to take months now takes minutes.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Toxic Exposure
programme.desc: In December of 1979, a young girl passes out on a bus in Wisconsin. She is taken to the hospital complaining of a sore throat, fever and aching muscles. Doctors believe she has the flu, until her blood pressure drops and her kidneys begin to fail. When additional women begin exhibiting similar symptoms, which bring them close to death, doctors fear an outbreak of toxic shock syndrome. The CDC and local health officials are alerted, triggering and intense investigation. After nearly one year, officials determine the cause of the outbreak, which has already killed seven.

programme.title: Happily Never After: Shattered Sisterhood
programme.desc: Sandy is shot two days before her wedding to Dave. The consequent investigation reveals an ex, and a mystery woman were involved, and not a botched robbery as first suspected.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis- We’ve all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder? While our handwriting may not reveal the nuances of our personalities, the dotting of the 'i’s and crossing of the 't's is an important business in criminal investigation. Apparent suicide notes, letters from suspected offenders and signatures are scrutinized down to the last dot. Handwriting comparisons can tell if the victim really did sign that new life insurance policy, or if the person who had everything to live for actually wrote the eloquent suicide note.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Deadly Spores
programme.desc: Canadian doctors are alarmed when a middle-aged woman dies of cryptococcal meningitis in 1999. Over the next few years, doctors see dozens of similar infections with pneumonia-like symptoms including shortness of breath, weight loss and severe headaches. Vancouver Island becomes home to the largest outbreak of the deadly fungus anywhere in the world. Local veterinarians report dozens of cases in the animal population, raising fears that the reach of the deadly fungus is not limited to any one species. DNA typing reveals that this new form of cryptococcus is identical to a strain normally found in Australia, leaving doctors with more questions than answers.

programme.title: Happily Never After: Hunted By Love
programme.desc: Cupid's arrow hits the mark with Bruce and his gal Janice. But during a three-month anniversary hunting trip, a bullet shatters their union. But who fired it?

Apparent suicide notes, letters from suspected offenders and signatures are scrutinized down to the last dot. Handwriting comparisons can tell if the victim really did sign that new life insurance policy, or if the person who had everything to live for actually wrote the eloquent suicide note.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Deadly Spores
programme.desc: Canadian doctors are alarmed when a middle-aged woman dies of cryptococcal meningitis in 1999. Over the next few years, doctors see dozens of similar infections with pneumonia-like symptoms including shortness of breath, weight loss and severe headaches. Vancouver Island becomes home to the largest outbreak of the deadly fungus anywhere in the world. Local veterinarians report dozens of cases in the animal population, raising fears that the reach of the deadly fungus is not limited to any one species. DNA typing reveals that this new form of cryptococcus is identical to a strain normally found in Australia, leaving doctors with more questions than answers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial- Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder. The jury heard hundreds of hours of testimony and every twist and turn of the trial was played out in the media, but what was the evidence? Forensic scientists reconstructed the events that took place on the night Nicole Brown Simpson was murdered. But was their report accurate, and could the evidence be trusted? We’ll examine what forensics could and could not tell us about the trial of the century.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Dangerous Contact
programme.desc: In 1993, aquatic researcher Joanne Burkholder suffers an array of troubling symptoms while working in her North Carolina State University lab. A fellow researcher confides that he has recently been plagued by bizarre medical problems including memory loss, confusion, numbness and a burning sensation on the skin, symptoms identical to Burkholder’s. One night Glasgow accidentally splashes aquarium water on his arm. Within minutes, lesions appear on his skin. A neurologist determines that the scientists’ symptoms are somehow related to their work with Pfiesteria, a single celled organism linked to increased fish kills in local rivers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics- A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It’s a question best solved by ballistics experts. Gunshot residues, the pathway of the bullet into the body, shells and the guns themselves all hold important clues. The ability to determine whether an individual has actually fired a gun is vitally important in homicide and suicide investigations.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Flash Eater
programme.desc: When an unpredictable germ terrifies Texas in 1998, the CDC and health officials alert all neighboring states and territories to be on the lookout for streptococcus outbreak, the same bacteria that causes strep throat. This new strain, however, will kill 33 people, causing flesh-eating viruses, introducing deadly toxins into the blood and introducing pneumonia. Before the bacteria is contained, physicians from the United States and Canada will have to work together to fight the deadly strain.

programme.desc: Get ready for a super fun underwater sing-along with The Sharksons! Join the fun as five little reef sharks learn their lesson about jumping on the bed. Then, meet an 'Itsy Bitsy' sea spider who keeps trying to climb an underwater cliff with a little help from her friends! The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty and a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Get ready for playground games and construction fun! First, the crew has to build a crazy golf course! After they finish, they decide to try it out, but something goes wrong every time! Then, at the beach, Digley and Dazey challenge each other to a sandcastle competition. They each build castles that get bigger and sillier, and after some bickering, they decide to build one giant castle together! Plus, learn the alphabet and sing 'If You're Happy and You Know It'!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join Digley, Dazey and the crew for a big day of rescues and learning! When the barn at Old MacDonald's Farm catches fire, the crew uses quick thinking to extinguish the flames. Then, a trip to the mountains goes wrong when an avalanche traps them in a tunnel, and they must find a clever way to escape! The rescues continue as Digley faces his fear of heights to restore a broken clock and the friends work together to save Scout after she falls down a hole during a thunderstorm.

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: It's time to play all the best games with Kii and Yii! The fun begins with a high-stakes game of Red Light, Green Light, where Jeepbot is 'It' with a slime cannon blaster! Then, Kii and Yii play a fun game of life-size Snakes and Ladders, complete with toy snakes and big ladders. The competition continues with a game of Duck, Duck, Goose in mini race cars and a summer pool party game of Marco Polo with Snappy Croc!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready to learn about animals, numbers, ABCs and more! Join Kii and Yii as they head to Old MacDonald's farm to learn all the sounds the animals make. Then it's time to learn numbers by singing along and counting the five cute penguins and five little ducks! The learning continues with a fun animal bus ride, a trip to space to sing 'Hey Diddle Diddle' and an important lesson on how to cross the road carefully with a mother cat and her kitten.

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: It's a dance party featuring all your favorite classic rhymes! Join JJ, Bella and Cece as they dance to 'Hey Diddle Diddle' while the cow jumps over the moon. The fun continues as they help their friend Humpty Dumpty get home after a great fall with the help of some sea creature friends! Then, get ready to rock out with a band of monkeys in a brand-new version of 'Rockabye Baby.' From 'Five Little Speckled Frogs' to 'Looby Loo,' it's a dance party full of classic fun!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Sing and play all day long! Give a sheep a bath on the farm, wait out the rain on a camping trip, and find out who the mysterious Muffin Man is. Have a surprise party in the treehouse and get ready for the day with TomTom and YoYo!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Alan Davies returns for a brand-new series of The Dog Rescuers and it's going to be bigger and better than ever. On this week's show, German Shepherd puppies covered in their own mess and eating raw meat off a filthy floor. They need Inspector Herchy Boal's help to get them out of their concrete cage.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: Puppy Academy
programme.desc: Follow 6 new furry students and their humans from their first day of puppy school training all the way to graduation. Watch and learn as our star students are taught the basics as well as a handy party trick ot two.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In the heart of London, Inspector Callum Isitt teams up with the police to track down four dogs, including two St Bernard types that have allegedly been beaten by their owners. One trail leads Callum to bustling Parliament Square, where it’s believed the St Bernard types are being used to get passers-by to part with their cash. Will he manage to find the dogs that he is looking for?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!nThey are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

Clemencia ofrece a Victoria guardarle el secreto de su romance y hacerle creer a Carmencita que andan juntas. Victoria y Pablo (Nicolás) se confiesan mutuamente que se aman; él está dispuesto a contarle todo lo que ella ignora sobre él.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E105
programme.desc: Fausto, narra detalladamente lo que sucedió hace años. Miente descaradamente, Torrealba piensa que quiere culpar a su esposa por haberle sido infiel. Camila reprocha duramente a la Madre Isabel. Rosa no puede aparecer púes quieren matarla. Axel, decepcionado porque Amelia le ocultó la paternidad de su hijo.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E04
programme.desc: Gertrudis, trama un tiroteo masivo para la fiesta. Alberto, enganchado en sus recuerdos del pasado de carta donde Lorenita le declaraba su amor. En el instituto de Oceanografía, Isabel sorprende a Malena con un ramo de flores como muestra de "admiración" por su nuevo nombramiento. Guillermo le hace ver a Lorena el peligro que corre su hijo, por haber huído de la casa Corona sin matar a Marco Aurelio.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E05
programme.desc: Lorena intenta despachar a Alberto, pero él sólo busca romper el hielo y juega haciendo alusión a sus amores infantiles; provocando aún más la rabia y los celos en Guillermo, que se mantiene amenazante - Ricardo decide contratar los servicios de electricista de María Bonita Echeverri, como una manera de aproximarse a una de las cuatro sospechosas con el mismo apellido Echeverri del hurto del cheque.

programme.desc: Frente a los médicos, Pastora finge interés por la condición de Clara Inés, Clara le toma con fuerza el brazo acusándola de lo que le ha pasado.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E106
programme.desc: Ezequiel en pugna con sus hijos. Camila los defiende y le dice que sus hijos le temen. Max está dispuesto a verse con Rosa, aún en peligro de su vida y Camila organiza una fiesta para desenmascarar a Elda.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E107
programme.desc: Camila presiona a Alfredo continuando con su plan, revela que Alfredo es el hijo de su madrina, al cual abandonó casi recién nacido. Hansen le pide disculpas a Victoria por haberle ocultado la identidad de Nicolás y menciona que pretende llamar a Hilario para disculparse también con él, aunque no sabe cómo reaccionará Guanipa ahora que murió Rosendo, noticia que sorprende a Victoria. programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E38 - HM The Queen A Remarkable Life
programme.desc: The most notable woman in modern times has to be our Late Queen, Elizabeth II. She ruled for 70 years, the longest reign in British history. Once a princess who wasn't supposed to be queen, Elizabeth II led the country to thrive after World War II and became a steady presence in our changing world. In a thousand years of British monarchy, Elizabeth II is likely one of the most outstanding monarchs ever.

programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S05:E07 - Gressenhall Workhouse Part 1
programme.desc: Karl investigates the very haunted school room in the large imposing Gressenhall Workhouse. The activity starts even before Karl gets into the building and becomes one of the most impressive investigations to date.

programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S05:E08 - Gressenhall Workhouse Part 2
programme.desc: Stuart investigates two buildings, a forge and the cottage. He could not have imagined the activity that folded around him.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E03 - Dropped And Dragging
programme.desc: Chris and Casey Keefer, two brothers, set off on another adventure in the wilds of Alaska. They're exploring a river system that hasn't been hunted in over ten years because of predators. The journey begins slowly, with the brothers spending more time dragging their gear than floating, in a place teeming with grizzlies.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E04 - Death In The Water
programme.desc: The search for a mature moose begins as brothers Chris and Casey Keefer move their way downriver, but when they cross paths with a giant sow grizzly, they get way more than they bargained for.

programme.desc: In Michigan's District 6, the walleye opener is one of the busiest weekends of the year; a 10-officer patrol works during the weekend to make sure everyone is safe and obeying the law.

programme.title: Wardens - S07:E14 - Firearms Opener
programme.desc: All across Michigan, officers spend the 16 days of the firearm deer season responding to all types of calls; from trespassing to poaching. Just when you think you've seen it all, something new pops up.

programme.desc: When Diana got engaged, she was constantly in the media's eyes. Throughout her life, she focused on her sons and committed herself to charity work, like speaking out against land mines. Diana used her fame to bring attention to this and other important issues. This well-researched show takes a closer look at one of the 20th century's most amazing people. programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E01 - Sinking Cities

programme.desc: The crew goes to Standon Hall, close to Stafford. This place used to be a hospital and nursing home, and there are stories about doors moving on their own, dishes crashing, and mysterious cries and moans.

programme.title: Most Haunted - S20:E09 - Standon Hall, Staffordshire Part 2
programme.desc: Dark shadows lead the team upstairs as they continue to explore the hall, but when noises lure two members of the team back to the kitchen one is hit on the head by a knife.

programme.title: Most Haunted - S20:E10 - Standon Hall, Staffordshire Part 3
programme.desc: The team conclude their investigation of the hall and outbuildings. Something appears to be following Fred, wheelchairs, books, a mug and even a birdcage are moved and apparitions are seen.

programme.desc: This big textile factory is rumored to be haunted by the spirits of the kids who used to work there and a 7-foot-tall ghostly figure conjured up by a dark ritual not too long ago. One team member had to leave early.

programme.title: Most Haunted - S20:E06 - Ripon Workhouse

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E56 - Mars Perseverance: The Hunt Begins
programme.desc: Watch as the Mars Perseverance Rover makes its historic landing on the Red Planet. We take you inside the harrowing February 18, 2021 landing, the science mission, and cutting-edge technology, including the first-ever Martian helicopter.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E62 - Drones in Space Mars to Titan
programme.desc: Drones have already conquered Earth, and now they're heading out into the solar system. The Mars Helicopter, Ingenuity is proving to be successful and will pave the way for Dragonfly, a future daring mission to Titan.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E780 - Voyage Into The Sun Extended Version
programme.desc: For the first time in history, NASA’s Parker Solar Probe has pierced the Sun’s corona and is orbiting above its surface. Scientists have a front-row seat to better understand the sun and predict huge solar eruptions that can cause serious damage when they hit Earth.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E74 - First Images The James Webb Telescope
programme.desc: The dawn of a new era in astronomy has begun as the world gets its first look at the full capabilities of NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E72 - Capturing A Black Hole In Our Milky Way
programme.desc: Astronomers linked radio dishes around the world to create the "Event Horizon Telescope" and have utilized this tool to photograph a supermassive black hole in the heart of our own Milky Way Galaxy. Its name is "Sagittarius A Prime" and it is over 4 million times more massive than the Sun.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E87 - Europa Clipper Mission to an Alien Ocean
programme.desc: Get ready for humanity's first deep dive into an alien ocean world! NASA's Europa Clipper heads to Jupiter's icy moons to explore the ultimate question: Is there life beyond Earth?

programme.desc: The EXO Mars and Curiosity continue their scientific discoveries as we prepare The New missions both robotic and manned to the Red planet Mars.

programme.title: Hashtag Proposal
programme.desc: A fake marriage proposal between two strangers . When all the attention starts to help them with their struggling lives and businesses, Millie and Leo play pretend, while trying to ignore their feelings.

programme.title: InstaFame
programme.desc: Since her divorce, Gwen and her teenage daughter Maddie make a great team and tell each other everything. It’s Maddie’s senior year and she’s excited to be reunited with her besties Kelly and Lacey again. Eager to be the coolest girls at school, the perfect way to gain instant popularity is posting selfies! When one of their social media stunts goes wrong, Maddie is blamed and the consequences are deadly. But Gwen knows she’s innocent. She’s determined to prove it and to protect her daughter from the real killer…

programme.title: The Story of Love
programme.desc: Ruby, an aspiring romance novelist, joins a writers retreat in Tahoe hosted by her literary hero and hottest writer around, Marcus Harlow, in order to win a lucrative book deal.
